claims.claim: Haven’t been used in about 3 years; just change the tires and oil the chain then you’re good to go.
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a bicycle with front/rear disc rotors, suspension fork, knobby tyres, and a rear cargo rack, but does not show usage history or chain/oil condition.
Brand/model/serial number is not readable; no receipt or date proof shown in the witness report.
Witness report shows disc brake rotors and reflectors/headlight, but no test of brake bite or gear shifting.
Single-angle photo does not clearly verify rust presence/absence across the frame, fork, chain, or rims.
Brand text is not fully readable and no component-level closeups are provided to confirm originality.

risks.risk: Tyres may be dry/cracked or not holding air after long storage; witness only confirms tyre type/appearance, not condition.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of tyre sidewalls and tread + a short clip showing the tyres inflated and not visibly flat (or a pressure check).
risks.if_unproven: Price as tyres needing replacement and/or tubes likely to be changed.

risks.risk: Brakes may not work well (pads worn, rotor warped, hydraulic/cable issues); witness only shows rotors, not performance.
risks.proof: Video clip of a brake test: squeeze both levers and show the wheel stopping firmly + close-up of brake pads thickness.
risks.if_unproven: Price as brakes may require service/parts.

risks.risk: Gears may not shift correctly (cables stretched, derailleur misalignment, chain worn); witness does not show shifting.
risks.proof: Video clip of shifting through all gears while pedaling + close-up of chain condition (no rust, minimal stretch).
risks.if_unproven: Price as gears may need adjustment and/or chain/cables replacement.

risks.risk: Suspension fork may be seized or leaking; witness only shows the fork visually.
risks.proof: Clip showing the fork compresses smoothly and rebounds + photo of fork seals/legs for oil leakage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as suspension may need servicing.

risks.risk: Wheels may be bent or rims worn; single angle cannot confirm true alignment or rim wear.
risks.proof: Video/clip spinning wheels to show wobble + close-up of rim wear and spoke tension.
risks.if_unproven: Price as wheels/rims may need truing or replacement.

risks.risk: Hidden frame damage (cracks/dents) not visible from one angle.
risks.proof: Multiple photos of the frame from all sides, especially around joints, head tube, and seat tube; include a close-up of any suspicious spots.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible structural issues until inspected.

risks.risk: Accessories/parts completeness (lock, pump, bell, lights, spare tubes) unknown.
risks.proof: Photo inventory of included accessories and any spare parts; show lights working if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as sold without extra accessories beyond what is clearly shown.

proof_requests: Send a short video of braking test (front and rear) showing firm stopping.
Send a short video of gear shifting through all gears while pedaling.
Provide close-ups of tyre tread and sidewalls (and confirm tyres hold air).
Provide close-ups of brake pads and rotors (including pad thickness).
Provide a clip showing the suspension fork compresses and rebounds smoothly; show fork seals for leaks.
Provide wheel spin video to check for wobble and close-ups of rim wear/spokes.
Provide multiple frame photos from different angles to check for cracks/dents; include any readable brand/model/serial.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies it as a black/blue bicycle with front suspension, disc brakes (front and rear), knobby tyres, and a rear cargo rack, so it can be priced at a worst-case used condition. Seller claims about usage, rust, and perfect gears/brakes are not verifiable from the provided evidence, so the price should assume service/parts may be needed.
